text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In honor of her outstanding<n>performance, Taiki
Shuttle receives<n>the URA award for best sprinter.
But<n>the Umamusume of the Year is none<n>other than
Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite the unfortunate results, Taiki<n>refuses to
give up. Citing my faith in<n>her speed, she declares
that she'll be<n>the next Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She vows to conquer all the G1<n>races—determined
to make her speed<n>and power known to as many
people<n>as she can.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our ambition renewed, we challenge<n>ourselves with
the Yasuda Kinen—the<n>race to crown the spring King
of the<n>Mile!
